source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The OtherHeader branch of onSelect checks the owned menupopup state. If it is not closed, it awaits a one-shot popuphidden listener before opening the modal Custom Headers dialog. The bound command listener preserves the widget receiver. After the dialog, the code uses a safe temporary value, rebuilds headers and restores the chosen or first item. The local comment names pointer-capture release as the reason; source ordering does not prove an engine capture contract or a cured focus hang. Other attribute choices do not take the popup wait.
title: Custom Headers waits for the owned search popup to close before opening its modal dialog
